thread:
Anya: Quick sync — Atlas asked for a guaranteed pin during migration but wants an automatic rollback bridge if quality regresses. Can we define a standard rollback-bridge runbook + gates?
Devon: @Anya +1. We need concrete metrics and a low-touch ops path. Proposed: canary (1% traffic) + automated quality checks against a seeded prompt set. If regression > threshold -> auto-shift to pinned variant.
Lucas: Proposed thresholds: ROUGE/bleu delta, perplexity, and business signals. For embeddings, cosine drop > 0.03 triggers. Need to map thresholds by model family.
Sam: Ops constraints: reroute in <30s, trace tokens across the route, and ensure we can warm KV cache on fallback. Also need a CLI/playbook to force revert.
Priya: Customer side asks: 3-month pin TTL for legacy contracts, plus opt-in to stay pinned beyond that. They also want a clear comms plan.
Anya: Draft runbook snippet:
```
Runbook: rollback-bridge
1) Canary -> 1% traffic for initial rollout; collect evals on seeded prompt set.
2) Eval window: early-exit check 4h, default 48h aggregation.
3) Metrics -> rouge_delta <= 0.5, p95_latency <= 350ms, embedding_cosine >= 0.92
4) If any critical metric fails -> automatic shift to pinned model + create SEV ticket and annotate route.
5) Manual override window: 60m after automated action.
```
Devon: Implementation notes: add route config flag `auto_rollback=true`. Routing layer compares eval stats from eval-service -> signaler -> routing. We can reuse cache & batch logic; need a lightweight signaler API.
Lucas: Need a baseline generation job (daily) + a seeded prompt repo `catalog/evals/atlas-v1`. Seed size ~500 prompts (mix of customer and synthetic). Eval harness should output per-prompt deltas + aggregated signal.
Sam: Timeline: Hosted + Dedicated = 3 sprints if we narrow scope. Private deployments will need KMS/audit signoff and isolated eval pipelines (add 2 sprints). Also ops runbook for backfilling KV cache on failover.
Anya: Launch checklist (current):
- Canaries + eval pipeline running end-to-end :white_check_mark:
- Auto-rollback toggle implemented behind FF :white_check_mark:
- Alerts wired to oncall + SEV templates :white_check_mark:
- Console comms + opt-in flow :in_progress:
- SLO doc updated with pin TTLs :in_progress:
Priya: I can own comms and opt-in UX. Question: can we add a "stick with me" override so customers can stay pinned even if quality drops? They asked for that.
Devon: Add tenant-level `force_pin=true` with Console warning modal about regression risk. We'll log a consent event for compliance.
Lucas: One more: 24h vs 48h eval window — 24h might be noisy for some workloads. Suggest default 48h, with fail-fast early exit if >2 critical regressions in first 4h.
Anya: Agree — update runbook with early-exit rule (fast-fail) + 48h aggregation.
Sam: Security note: for Private mode, eval payloads must stay in VPC. Mark that in spec as a hard requirement.
Devon: Action items summary:
- Devon: spike routing flag + signaler (WIP) -> PR by EOD Fri
- Lucas: assemble seed prompts + eval harness -> repo PR by next Tue
- Priya: comms draft + opt-in copy -> initial draft by Mon
- Anya: update runbook doc + formalize launch checklist -> EOW
Anya: If no objections I'll lock these gates into the onboarding spec and add a sample rollback policy to the catalog templates. :rocket: 
Devon: No objections from me. :+1:
Lucas: Fine with me — will post seed plan in `#eng-ml` after PR.
Priya: Adding customer notes and timeline to the Atlas ticket.
Sam: I'll draft the ops CLI commands and cache-warm playbook snippet.
Anya: Thanks all — I'll push the spec update and ping for a quick async review.
